name: University of Southern California
feeMethod: Charges one flat undergraduate tuition for every major, so every major costs the same. Master's use their school's per-unit or flat graduate rate.
description: The University of Southern California is a private research university in Los Angeles, California, founded in 1880. It is known for engineering, business, film and communication.
whyIncluded: The USC Alumni Association has a Singapore alumni club for Trojans living or working in Singapore.

livingCosts.summary: USC's own budget for an undergraduate living on campus for two semesters: housing, food, transport, books and personal costs. Excludes tuition and fees.
livingCosts.notes: 2026-27 undergraduate cost of attendance, living on campus, two semesters: housing $13,510; food $8,442; transportation $1,188; books and supplies $670 + personal and miscellaneous $2,016 = personal. Two semesters taken as 9 months (the page does not state months).

programmes.name: Mechanical Engineering (BS)
programmes.feeBasis: USC's single 2026-27 flat undergraduate tuition (12-18 units, two semesters), the same for every major, plus fees and a one-off new student fee.
programmes.summary: Yearly tuition for USC undergraduates, the same for all majors and for international students, plus mandatory fees and a one-time new student fee. Rises most years; health insurance not included.
programmes.notes: USC Financial Aid cost of attendance, 2026-27 undergraduate: tuition (12-18 units for two semesters) $75,384, fees $1,952, plus a $450 new student fee in the first semester (one-off). 2025-26 on the same page: tuition $73,260, fees $1,902 (new student fee for that year not shown, so current one-off used). The page does not itemise 'fees'; no health insurance line is included. Flat-rate tuition, same for all majors. Not cohort-locked. Viterbi School of Engineering. 2024-25 row from USC Thornton School of Music's official 'Academic Year 2024-2025' undergraduate cost sheet (read 2026-10-13): flat-rate tuition (12-18 units) $69,904; fees = Student Health Service $1,300 + Student Programming $128 + Norman Topping Student Aid $22 + Student Transportation Fee $234 = $1,684 (music-only instruction fee and health insurance excluded); New Student fee $450 one-time.

programmes.name: MS in Mechanical Engineering
programmes.feeBasis: USC Viterbi's 2026-27 rate of US$2,742 per unit (same for all its master's) times 18 units, the 9 units a semester its own cost sheet assumes, plus mandatory fees.
programmes.summary: Yearly tuition for an international Viterbi master's student taking 9 units a semester (charged per unit), plus mandatory fees and a one-time orientation fee. Health insurance not included.
programmes.notes: USC Viterbi 2026-27 cost-of-attendance sheet (33-unit master's): graduate engineering tuition $2,742 per unit; the sheet assumes 9 units in each of the first two semesters, so annual = 18 x $2,742 = $49,356. Other fees = mandatory fees $922 per semester x2 (student health service, programming, transportation, Topping Student Aid Fund); one-off = $55 orientation fee. Health insurance (2025-26 rates $1,224 fall, $2,298 spring/summer) excluded. 2025 history from the 2025-26 sheet: $2,665 per unit x 18 = $47,970; fees $897 per semester x2 = $1,794; orientation $55. All Viterbi master's programmes are charged the same per-unit rate; total cost depends on the programme's unit count (27-33 units, typically four semesters). Not cohort-locked. 2024 history from the Viterbi 2024-2025 sheet (read 2026-10-13): $2,543 per unit x 18 = $45,774; mandatory fees $873 per semester x2 = $1,746 (the sheet's Fall 2024 $928 includes the $55 orientation fee); orientation $55.

programmes.notes: Same fee basis as the existing Business Administration (BS): USC Financial Aid cost of attendance, 2026-27 undergraduate: tuition (12-18 units, two semesters) $75,384, fees $1,952, plus $450 new student fee in the first semester (one-off). Flat-rate tuition, same for all majors. 2025-26 on the same page: tuition $73,260, fees $1,902. 2024-25 from USC Thornton's official 'Academic Year 2024-2025' undergraduate cost sheet: flat tuition $69,904; fees Student Health Service $1,300 + Programming $128 + Topping $22 + Transportation $234 = $1,684; new student fee $450. The $450 new student fee for 2025 is taken from the ARR fee schedule (Orientation/New Student Fee, undergraduate $450). Not cohort-locked.

programmes.name: Master of Accounting (MAcc)
programmes.feeBasis: USC's Fall 2026 graduate flat rate (15-18 units) of US$37,692 doubled for two semesters, for the 30-unit one-year MAcc; students without an accounting background take 45 units and pay more.
programmes.summary: Yearly tuition for the full-time Master of Accounting at USC Leventhal (30-unit track, two semesters at 15 units each), plus mandatory fees and a one-time orientation fee. Health insurance not included.
programmes.notes: USC Registrar tuition schedule: 'Graduate Students (15-18 units)' flat rate, which Marshall's MAcc admissions page directs full-time MAcc students to; Fall 2026 $37,692 per semester x2 = $75,384 (Spring 2027 rate not yet published, assumed equal to Fall 2026, as for undergraduates). Previous years from Common Crawl captures of the same Registrar page: 2025-26 $36,630 per semester x2 = $73,260; 2024-25 Spring 2025 $34,952 per semester x2 = $69,904 (equals the 2024-25 flat graduate and undergraduate rate on the Thornton sheet). The MAcc is 30 units for students with an accounting background (fall start) and 45 units without (summer start plus a $15,350 summer intensive); the 30-unit one-year track is used here, so students without an accounting background pay more. Mandatory fees (student health service, programming, transportation, Topping fund) are university-wide for graduate students at the University Park campus; taken from USC Viterbi's published per-semester mandatory totals: $922 x2 = $1,844 (2026-27), $897 x2 = $1,794 (2025-26), $873 x2 = $1,746 (2024-25); graduate orientation fee $55 one-off. Marshall publishes no MAcc tuition page. Health insurance excluded. Not cohort-locked.
